name: SART (Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique)
aliases: Modified SART for Data Term Proximal Operator
definition: A solver for the data term proximal operator in the proximal optimization framework for CT reconstruction, preferred over Conjugate Gradient (CG) for sparse-view settings.
summary: SART is an iterative algebraic reconstruction technique that updates volumes per scan view, offering modest memory and superior performance over direct methods in limited projection scenarios.
